Book

Request an appointment

Booking is personal here, like everything else: send your request via WhatsApp and we agree the time together. A request is not yet a confirmed appointment.

  1. Step 1

    Treatment

    Choose what you would like; prices and durations are in the catalogue.

  2. Step 2

    Details

    Tell us your hair length and anything we should know.

  3. Step 3

    Date

    Suggest days or times that suit you; we are open Wednesday, Friday and Saturday.

  4. Step 4

    Confirm

    We reply personally to agree the exact time. Your request becomes an appointment once we confirm it.

Your request

Submitting opens WhatsApp with your request ready to send. Your appointment is agreed and confirmed in the conversation that follows; sending the message does not reserve a slot.

Colour is agreed in person first

A consultation is required before a first colour, toner, highlight or Gracefully Grey treatment, and before major colour changes, colour corrections and hair that has previously been coloured, lightened or chemically treated. The €25 consultation fee is fully deducted from the agreed treatment. Book the consultation first; the treatment is then booked at the agreed price and duration.

Hair length, in plain words

Short hair: Hair that falls above the jawline.

Medium-length hair: Hair from the jawline to just above the shoulders, including a bob that remains above the shoulders.

Long hair: Hair that touches or falls below the shoulders.

Very long hair: Hair that reaches the mid-back or below; an additional charge may apply.

Good to know

Prices and appointment times are based on the selected hair length and an average amount of hair. A surcharge of €12.50 may apply to exceptionally thick, very long or tangled hair, or when substantially more product and time are required. This will always be discussed before the treatment begins.

Please tell us before your appointment about allergies, scalp conditions, sensitivities, medication or previous reactions to colouring products.
